description: Track a repo's work on a live Kaneo board instead of in-repo task files, so parallel sessions stop claiming the same task and no branch grows its own backlog. Ships the workflow skill, the board's MCP server definition, a reference manager agent, and hooks that keep claim authority in the root session, block board writes while the config is incomplete, catch a stray MCP registration that would silently authenticate the owner instead of the agent, and stamp every write with its agent and session. Configure with five KANEO_* env vars; nothing about an instance is baked in. Release history: https://github.com/hsb3/dotfiles-agents/releases.
name: kaneo
